factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue breakdown table shows H1 2026 mobile services EUR 100,022 thousand (100.022m, +8.3%), fixed services EUR 112,920 thousand (112.92m, +5.3%), equipment EUR 46,142 thousand (46.142m, +9.6%).

factual_claims.claim: Within fixed services, IT services were particularly strong, increasing 23.9% to EUR 19.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue breakdown table shows H1 2026 IT services EUR 19,775 thousand (19.775m, +23.9%) under fixed services.

factual_claims.claim: Mobile subscriptions increased 3.3% to 1.731 million, supported by 4.2% growth in post-paid subscriptions, while broadband and TV customer numbers declined modestly.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating figures table shows mobile subscriptions 1,731 thousand (+3.3%), post-paid 1,493 thousand (+4.2%), broadband 405 thousand (-2.4%), TV 254 thousand (-1.2%).

factual_claims.claim: Profitability improved faster than revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights show EBITDA up 9.5% vs revenue up 7.2%, operating profit up 15.1% vs revenue up 7.2%.

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA rose 9.5% to EUR 105.5 million, exceeding EUR 100 million for the first time, and the EBITDA margin increased from 39.9% to 40.7%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table shows EBITDA EUR 105,468 thousand (105.468m, +9.5%) with margin 40.7% vs 39.9% in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA excluding non-recurring items grew 10.2% to EUR 106.9 million, with the margin rising to 41.3%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state adjusted EBITDA excluding non-recurring items up 10.2% to EUR 106.9 million with margin 41.3%.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit increased 15.1% to EUR 62.4 million, while profit before tax rose 16.6% to EUR 61.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table shows operating profit (EBIT) EUR 62,420 thousand (62.42m, +15.1%) and profit before tax EUR 61,277 thousand (61.277m, +16.6%).

factual_claims.claim: Profit for the period increased 14.7% to EUR 51.3 million, lifting the profit margin from 18.5% to 19.8% and earnings per share from EUR 0.077 to EUR 0.088.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table shows profit for period EUR 51,326 thousand (51.326m, +14.7%) with margin 19.8% vs 18.5%, EPS basic/diluted EUR 0.088 vs 0.077.

factual_claims.claim: Cost of goods and services increased 2.3%, reflecting higher equipment sales volumes and increased network interconnection and roaming costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section states cost of goods and services up 2.3% due to higher equipment sales volumes and increased network interconnection/roaming costs.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses excluding non-recurring items rose 10.2%; energy expenses increased 14.3%, external IT service costs 18.4%, and expenses for common Group functions also increased.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section states operating expenses excluding non-recurring items up 10.2%, with specific mentions of energy +14.3%, external IT services +18.4%, and common Group function increases.

factual_claims.claim: Employee-related expenses included EUR 1.4 million of redundancy costs associated with restructuring the Digital & Technology unit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section explicitly states employee-related expenses rose due to EUR 1.4 million non-recurring redundancy costs from Digital & Technology unit restructuring.

factual_claims.claim: Despite these cost pressures, revenue growth and operating leverage supported the improvement in margins.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Inferred from financial highlights showing revenue growth (7.2%) outpaced cost growth (COGS +2.3%, OPEX ex non-recurring +10.2%) leading to margin expansion (EBIT margin +0.6pp).
factual_claims.source_evidence_detail: Financial highlights and margin analysis confirm operating leverage drove margin improvement despite cost pressures.

factual_claims.claim: Income tax expense increased 27.0%, partly reflecting Lithuania’s increase in the profit tax rate from 16% to 17%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to financial statements show income tax expense up 27.0% (EUR 9,951k vs 7,833k) and explicitly state tax rate increased from 16% to 17% from 1 Jan 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation strengthened, with operating cash flow up 15.0% to EUR 103.1 million and free cash flow up 12.5% to EUR 64.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows operating cash flow EUR 103,131 thousand (103.131m, +15.0%) and free cash flow EUR 64,099 thousand (64.099m, +12.5%).

factual_claims.claim: Capital investments increased 57.9% to EUR 37.5 million, including EUR 9.7 million for 5G spectrum licenses, EUR 6.1 million for the mobile network and EUR 14.2 million for IT systems and infrastructure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments section shows total capex EUR 37,458 thousand (37.458m, +57.9%) with breakdown: 5G spectrum licenses EUR 9,690k, mobile network EUR 6,116k, IT systems EUR 14,174k.

factual_claims.claim: In June, the company acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million and extended its 2,100 MHz spectrum rights for EUR 2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments section states: 'In June, the Company acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million... and extended the right to use the 2,100 MHz frequency band... for EUR 2 million.'

factual_claims.claim: The company cited annual mobile data traffic growth of about 25% as requiring continued network capacity investment.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO comment states: 'Mobile data traffic in Lithuania is growing by around 25 per cent annually... This consistently increases the load and requires continuous investment in capacity...'

factual_claims.claim: The company paid EUR 81.6 million in dividends for 2025, or EUR 0.14 per share.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends section states: 'On 21 May 2026, the Company paid out to the shareholders an amount of EUR 81.6 million of dividends or EUR 0.14 per share for the year 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Following the payment, shareholders’ equity declined 7.5% from year-end to EUR 372.0 million, while net debt remained negative at EUR 4.3 million and the company had no outstanding loans.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of changes in equity shows equity at 30 June 2026: EUR 372,043 thousand (372.043m) vs 402,283 thousand (402.283m) at 31 Dec 2025 (-7.5%). Statement of financial position shows net debt (4,255 thousand) and explicitly states 'As of 30 June 2026, the Company had no outstanding loans.'

factual_claims.claim: The interim financial statements are unaudited.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 1 states: 'These financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 are not audited.'
